declarations.name: AuiSchedulePicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI SchedulePicker: `<aui-schedule-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Legend of the fieldset (required accessible name).

inputs.name: timeZones
inputs.description: Timezones offered in a select; omitted: no select.

inputs.name: recurrence
inputs.description: Embed a Recurrence Picker (read at creation).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name of the hidden input (iCalendar text).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by the fieldset.

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First column of the calendars and weekday toggles.

inputs.name: defaultDuration
inputs.description: Minutes of a new timed schedule after switching off all-day.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Timezone of the wall-clock times when the value has none and no select is shown.

inputs.name: disambiguation
inputs.description: DST policy for wall-clock times in a gap or overlap (SPEC section 8.5).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed a part of the schedule or its validity error.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared on the next edit.

accessibility.pattern: A fieldset composing labelled pickers (APG date picker dialogs), a native checkbox and select, and an optional Recurrence Picker fieldset.

limitations: One timezone for start and end.
The end follows the start with the previous duration; there is no separate duration field.
All-day schedules have no times; switching back to timed restores the previous start time (09:00 by default) and duration.
parseSchedule accepts TZID, UTC (Z), and VALUE=DATE forms only.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
